messages:
Anna: Morning — quick proposal: rotate agenda owner for the weekly product-eng sync. Current cadence has same owners for months which is creating a backlog of ownership tasks. Suggest a 2-week steward rotation + an explicit "quiet hours" rule: no triage pings 24h before the sync. Thoughts? @Keon @Priya

Keon: +1 on rotation. Do we want 2-week or 1-week? 2-week reduces churn and gives owners time to prep.

Priya: 2-week sounds good. Quiet hours are fine but we need a clear SEV1 exception.

Jared: +1 for 2-week. For exceptions, can we add an "urgent lane" agenda slot (2 minutes) to surface blockers only? Keeps noise down.

Anna: sgtm. Drafted a minimal schedule and handoff checklist below — please skim:

```
Week A: Owner = KEON
Week B: Owner = PRIYA
Owner duties:
- collect 3 items by Thu 5pm
- add owners + slack links to the agenda doc
- reserve one 5m OT slot for urgent lane
Quiet hours: no triage pings Fri 00:00 - Mon 00:00 unless SEV1
```

Anna: Poll link: https://polls.redwood/weekly-rotations (please vote by EOD Thu) :ballot_box_with_check:

Keon: can we add a requirement to file a 1-line decision log entry after the sync? makes follow-ups easier and keeps context in one place.

Priya: agree on the decision log requirement. Where should we keep the agenda template? I can move a copy to /docs/meetings/agenda-template.md and point the agenda doc there.

Jared: tiny nit — timezone for handoff reminders. Can calendar-bot auto-send reminders to the owner 48h before?

calendar-bot: Reminder rule created: will DM the agenda owner 48h before their week and add the owner to the sync calendar event.

Keon: perfect. Also propose rotating meeting time across AM/PM once a quarter so on-call folks in other regions don't always get the bad slot.

Anna: good call. Let's trial this whole flow for 2 months and then formalize if it's working. I'll update the agenda doc, add the rotation table and the decision-log requirement after votes close.

Priya: voted. thanks!

Jared: voted too. :thumbsup:
